description: The new eagerly imported integration package is not added to setup.py's explicit packages list.
trigger: Build and install a distribution using the unchanged explicit package list, then import exllamav3 outside the source checkout.
expected_behavior: The installed distribution should contain the integration package that its root initializer imports.
actual_behavior: setup.py explicitly lists the existing packages but omits exllamav3.integration, while the task adds an unconditional import of it. The inspected packaging configuration therefore does not select the new package.
